clauses.clause: Backyard alleys on the depot/Annex line: no snag on trash bags/pallets/bench corners; the camera-side fence never hides the player.
clauses.note: Both qualities:18 backyard passage legs plus7 focused depot-bench785 legs each (50 measured legs total), all endpoints <=0.12m, maximum stopped ticks1 (1/60s), every movement sample on foot carrying the parcel.166 current photographs personally inspected at actual follow-camera zoom0.5/1/1.5: trash bags, pallets, bins and bench corners passed without snag; camera-side fences cut away and never hide the courier. Physical WASD input with read-only coordinate assistance after ordinary parcel pickup; no God mode, teleport, spawn or skip. Full raw traces retain excluded off-route house/front-fence probes10/11 and unreachable straight-line Annex probe20: these target authored solids outside the qualified passages; their stops are disclosed route-assist limitations and do not support this PASS. Focused bench route goes around the parked cargo bike and passes both corners of the actual depot bench.
